source.title: Weston EB, Aurand A, Dufour JS, Knapik GG, Allread WG, Marras WS. An objective set of guidelines for pushing and pulling. Spine Research Institute, The Ohio State University (BWC/OSU push/pull guidelines PDF)

tables.title: Guidelines for Straight Pushing and Pulling With Two Hands (Limits in lbs.)
tables.locator: BWC/OSU guidelines PDF, page 3 (the document has no printed page numbers; PDF page 3 of 5)

passA.method: Machine extraction of the PDF text layer with tools/transcription/extract-bwc-osu.ts (Poppler pdftotext -bbox word coordinates; layout parameters only)

passB.method: Manual reading of page images rendered with Poppler pdftoppm at 100 and 200 dpi, written before pass A existed

tables.notes: The Action cell is merged across rows in the source; both passes write it on every row. Line breaks inside a heading are replaced by single spaces, and the two heading lines of each band column are joined.

tables.title: Guidelines for Straight and Turning Pulling With 1 Hand (Limits in lbs.)
tables.locator: BWC/OSU guidelines PDF, page 4, lower table

passA.method: Machine extraction of the PDF text layer with tools/transcription/extract-bwc-osu.ts (Poppler pdftotext -bbox word coordinates; layout parameters only)

passB.method: Manual reading of page images rendered with Poppler pdftoppm at 100 and 200 dpi, written before pass A existed

tables.notes: The Action cell is merged across rows in the source; both passes write it on every row. Line breaks inside a heading are replaced by single spaces, and the two heading lines of each band column are joined. The first pass A run placed the heading word 'Hand' (x = 94 points) in the Action column because the Action boundary was set at x = 100 points. The boundary was corrected to x = 90 points, which is still right of every Action word (x = 45 to 76 points), and pass A was regenerated. The data cells were identical in both runs.
